meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试先行方式开发新功能并修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是开发时习惯先写测试、再让代码通过的工程师
copy.tagline_en: Build features and fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice red-green-refactor and want tests to drive your code

howto.what: Claude 会按 red → green 循环带你做测试驱动开发:先写失败的测试,再写刚好让测试通过的最小实现,每次只推进一个垂直切片,测试只写在事先与你确认的公开接口(seam)上。
howto.when: 当你想以测试先行方式开发功能或修 bug、提到「red-green-refactor」,或需要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 帮我做这个功能,先写一个失败的测试
say.note: 它会先和你确认要测的 seam

say.text: 我们确认一下这次要测的 seam 是哪些
say.note: 未确认的 seam 不写测试

say.text: 帮我看看这个测试是不是实现耦合或同义反复

howto.what_en: Claude runs the red → green TDD loop with you: write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it, one vertical slice per cycle. Tests are written only at seams you confirmed up front.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD for this feature; write the failing test first
say_en.note: It confirms the seams with you first

say_en.text: Let's agree on which seams we'll test
say_en.note: No test is written at unconfirmed seams

say_en.text: Check whether this test is implementation-coupled or tautological
